title: Sailing Into The Unknown
summary:
Iran conflict creates massive uncertainty
It is rare for us to cover the same topic two Tanker Opinions in a row, but these are unusual circumstances. Last Friday, we discussed several possible scenarios with respect to Iran in our Opinion titled "Will He Or Won't He?". On Saturday morning, the answer came.
